## Wave 6, list 3 (T-9130)
Ticket [[tickets/T-9130-wave-6-list-3]]. 37 functions matched (10,736 bytes); 27 rows added to [[data/t0018-cases]]. New or confirmed patterns:
- **GameState member names carry three digits below 0x100.** `D_800E62BA` is `D_800E6280.unk_03A`, `D_800E62BE` is `unk_03E`; `unk_3A` is a member of another struct and compiles with a warning to the wrong offset. Look the field up in `main_api.h` before writing a cast (`*(u8 *)&D_800E6280.unk_3E` produced a wrong "load order" difference in DATE2 `func_80137A2C`; the plain `unk_03E` matched at once).
- **A constant-second compare needs an array, not a scalar.** Three flags at `D_8015EBCC/EBD0/EBD4` tested with `== 1` give `bne value,const` for scalars but the original has `bne const,value`: declare `extern s32 D_8015EBCC[3]` and test `[0]`, `[1]`, `[2]` (RPG_BAT `func_801513C8`). Same ILOD rule as the TAIIKU `D_801491E0[4]` note in "Selector register rule (T-5010)".
- **`s32` state function without a return** also covers GameState bytes: `if (unk_03A >= 3U) unk_03A -= 2; else {...}` in an `s32 f(void)` gives the `or v0,t6,zero` copy (OPTION `func_801387E4`); the companion `func_80132AB8` is plain `if (unk_03A >= 2U) unk_03A -= 2;` with three tests of the member. RPG_BAT switch dispatchers (`func_8014F790`, `func_801504E0`) and TACO `func_8013587C` follow the same rule.
- **A rolled loop of 256 stores 0x20 apart is a `0x20`-step loop** (TT `func_80142D40`, the note in the loops section): `for (i = 0; i < 0x2000; i += 0x20) *(s16 *)(p + i) = 0;`. The `RECT` needs the w/h one-line `FAKE` of the neighbour.
- **Local string and table frames need a pad above them** when the original frame has 4 or 12 bytes above the local: `s32 pad;` before `u8 buf[3] = "..."` (SHUGAKU `func_8013799C`, DATE2 `func_801378A4`), before a 0xCC3-byte `DateTxt` copy (DATE2 `func_80137A2C`), `u8 b` after `u8 a` for byte locals at sp+0x2B/0x29 (GYOZI `func_80140AFC`), `s32 pad[3]` between two spilled pointers (TT `func_8013CA0C`). All `FAKE` comments; the real source declared other locals.
- **Local fptab with two tables** (KANGEI `func_80138158`): `s32 idx; FnTbl67 a; FnTbl68 b;` matches; the scalar above both tables is the 4 bytes of the T-3330 rule. A table with a `u8 v` after it (EVENT `func_800FD00C`) fixes a frame 8 bytes short but the `lui v1` of the final load stays different (permuter 10 with a dead `if (1) {}`).
- **Repeated `D_800B0A04[k].unk_xx` offsets**: EVENT scenes touch `D_800B0A04[2]`, `[4]`, `[6]`, `[9]` (`D_800B0A6E` = `[2].unk_02`, `D_800B0B3E` = `[6].unk_02`, `D_800B0BDA` = `[9].unk_02`). A scalar `D_800B094E` that sits before the table needs the `*(s16 *)((u8 *)D_800B0A04 - 0xB6)` form of the neighbour (EVENT `func_801071D8`).
- **Compare chains read from an aggregate view**: `RpgRec18 D_8015EC58` supplies `D_8015EC5C..6C` (`func_80151984`); a 41-pointer string table copied to a local with three drawn indices as `s32 a, b, c; StrTbl41 tbl;` (declaration order a, b, c, tbl) puts them at sp+0xD4, 0xD0, 0xCC and the table at sp+0x28 (RPG_BAT `func_80150F84`).
- **Not buildable: gcc-compiled SDK code inside overlays.** DATE `func_8015A980` (`RotMatrixZ`-like, `addu rd,rs,$zero`, `negu`, `j`, `nop` after `mflo`) and TT `func_8014D260` are PsyQ gcc output like the TACO `func_8015D270` family; only IDO is wired for overlays.
- **Known gaps hit again** (rows in [[data/t0018-cases]]): selector `$v1` vs `$v0` (BUNKAKEN `func_80140F60`, RPG_BAT `func_80150B90`), swap of two globals in `$v1/$v0` (main `func_80086640`), `$a0` shared constants in init sequences (GYOZI `func_8013AC38`, `func_8013D294`), address-CSE of `&D_800E6280` (main `icon_disp_switch`), phantom `$a1/$a2` constants (TT `func_801436BC`), global promoted into `$v0` for the return value (SHUGAKU `func_801385A8`), `* 0x38` via `multu` (SHOUGATU `func_8013BC2C`).
## Wave 6, list 8 (T-9180)
Ticket [[tickets/T-9180-wave-6-list-8]]. 38 functions matched (13,328 bytes); 22 more were tried and left as `INCLUDE_ASM` with a row in [[data/t0018-cases]] (all `regorder`). What was new:
- **Own data, main exe (`80057390`)**: `tools/data_island.py main/80057390` plus `s32 D_800B5920[4]` (the four `sw $zero` under one `lui $at` of `dec_bg_reset` are elements of one array, not four scalars) matched `dec_bg_reset` and `func_8005751C` (an `s32` function that returns the case value from each `case`, no final `return`). The array name has to be added to `config/symbol_addrs_types.txt` once overlay C (ENDING) uses it: an overlay links against `build/main_names.ld`, and the island's labels only reach it through the asm that still names them.
- **TACO actor functions (`D_8015EDB4[arg0]`, `TcActor`, stride 0x88)**: `(arg0 + D_8015EDB4)->f` gives `addu x,idx,base` and `D_8015EDB4[arg0].f` gives `addu x,base,idx`, and the original mixes both statement by statement. Read the operand order of every `addu` in the asm and pick the spelling per statement (matched this way: `func_80156924` all `(arg0 + D)->`, `func_80159678`, `func_8015A378`, `func_80155230`, `func_80159F60`, `func_8015A680`, `func_80155F98`). Hints: a spill `sw $aN,0x28($sp)` of `arg0 * 0x88` (m2c prints `sp28 = arg0 * 0x88`) means the `(arg0 + D)->` form; the pointer in `m2c` that is reused for several fields is not the form to copy (it shows the CSE, not the source). Operand order of sums and products also matters for the registers: `D[arg0].unk7C + ((0x3E8 - x) * f(..) >> 0xD)` against `(f(..) * (0x3E8 - x) >> 0xD) + unk7C`.
- **TACO position-by-value functions** (`func_8015ACCC(a, b, c, d, e, f, g)`, `func_8013DB80(pos, w, h)`): the locals are `TcPos` slots in declaration order, first declared highest (`pos`, `vel`, `s32 id`, `s32 r`); an unused leading `TcPos p0` is how the frame gets its extra 8 bytes (`func_80154F74`, `func_8015A164`, `func_8015595C`, same as `func_80156F50`). The `c` argument is the TcPos the asm copies first to sp+8 (often the same local as `e`, `func_80154F74` passes `vel, pos, vel`). `func_80156178` needs the `x` and `y` stores on one source line (permuter, marked `FAKE`).
- **Empty string**: a one-word `.word 0` in the rodata of a scene-init function is `""` (`func_8006612C("")`, `func_80036884("")`), not a table (GEKO `func_8013C73C`, `func_8014016C`, `func_8013F0BC`, EVENT `func_801004F0`). `funcdiff` shows only the `.rodata` relocation for these; the unit sha1 decides.
- **Pass-through `s32` switch chains on `unk_110D`/`unk_110A`** with the selector in `$v1` and `or $v0,$v1,$zero` in the first delay slot: declare the function `s32` without a final `return` and use `return;` for the cases that jump past the frame restore (OLH help pages `func_80135DD4`, `func_80135EC0`, `func_80136000`, `func_80136124`, `func_801362C4`, `func_801363CC`, TEL `func_8013A2F0`, `func_80139E90`, TACO `func_80133980`; the callers' prototypes in the overlay header change `void` to `s32`).
- **Flag word of `GameState.unk_66C[i]`** (`lbu; ori 0x40; sb` through a byte of a 4-byte slot): a bit-field type `{ u32 pad0:25; u32 grade:2; u32 pad1:3; u32 flag:1; u32 pad2:1; }` and `((Slot *)&D_800E6280.unk_66C[idx])->flag = 1` skips the register IDO would number differently with the byte field (MASTER `func_80133374`, `func_8013B20C`; the type exists in ETC and KANGEI too).
- **`u16` word compared with a post-increment**: `if ((u32)D_800E6280.unk_1104.w++ >= 0x400)` gives `sltiu; xori; sw` (SHOUGATU `func_8013F3C0`, DATE `func_8013EE3C`).
- **Loops over 11 or 12 Rec38 records** are unrolled by 4 by IDO as in the original (`for (i = 1; i < 0xD; i++) unk_1BC[i].unk_02 += 0x14`, MASTER `func_80133374`).
- **Locals needing a spare slot** (marked `FAKE`): DATE `func_8013EE3C` (`s32 pad` above a 0x2A-byte table copy), TEL `func_80139E90` (`s32 pad` above the two string buffers). OLH `func_80135CB4` reads the s8 field `unk_1093` with `lbu` in the switch (`*(u8 *)&`, `FAKE`).
- **Not reproducible, the common causes** (rows in [[data/t0018-cases]]): operand registers numbered one higher or lower than IDO (`func_80155C64`, `func_80155E10`, `func_8013B448`, `func_8013E524`, `func_8013E094`); constants the original keeps in one register across stores or loops (`func_8013FA6C`, `func_80137D1C`, `func_80134658`, `func_801411DC`); fields the original reads through their own symbols while the surrounding code uses the GameState base (`func_80140FD0`, `func_801403A0`, `func_80136A74`, `func_80136B70`, `func_80140B08`); back-branch delay slots filled by IDO but `nop` in the original (`func_80057710`).
## Wave 6, list 7 (T-9170)
Ticket [[tickets/T-9170-wave-6-list-7]]. What worked, by pattern (details per function in the commits):
1. **`s32` without a return fixes more than the selector copy.** A function whose original ends with `or v0,t6,zero` after an assignment (`D = (D + 1) & 0xFF` with the value left in `$v0`), a `nop` in the first branch slot (`$v0` live at the exit), or `or v0,v1,zero` after a switch is an `s32` function with no `return`: BUNKA_SD `func_80134314`, `func_801389DC`, NAME_ENT `func_80141FA4`, RPG_BAT `func_8013C1CC`. m2c draws these as `u8 f()` with `var_v0` temporaries; do not copy that. The header prototype changes from `void` to `s32` (overlay-local header, one line).
2. **Neighbouring symbols through one base.** as1 hoists a load above a store to another symbol, the original does not when both are fields of one record table: `(&D_800E9E3E)[0x22] += 0x40; D_800E9E3E += 0x40;` (EVENT `func_8010B678`), `(&D_800F5AAE)[0x9CC] += 5` (GYOZI `func_80137D70`), `(&D_800E9E5F)[-0x44] |= 0x80` and `*(s32 *)(D_800EC190 + 0x24)` (EVENT `func_8010B570`), `D_801474A0 = (&D_80147440)[9]` (GYOZI `func_8013C91C`). The tell is a pair of symbols 0x24/0x44 apart where the original keeps load-after-store order and the draft hoists.
3. **IDO unrolling peels the remainder first.** A 13-trip loop is `1 + 3 x 4` (NAME_ENT `func_80142A3C`), a 10-trip loop `2 + 2 x 4` with a counter that starts at 2, a 9-trip loop `1 + 2 x 4` with the pointer at `base + 2` (TT `func_80147F14`: `for (i = 1; i < 10; i++)` over `*(s16 *)(p + 0x4E + 2 * i)`). With the loop body on the `for` line the delay slot of the back branch takes the first store like the original (`FAKE`).
4. **A global read once at the top** (`q = D_80158A74;` before the `if`) puts the load in `$v0` before the branch like the original (TT `func_80147F14`); declare an index/pointer variable in the order of first use to get `$s1`/`$s2` right (TT `func_801480BC`: `a` before `i`).
5. **All the `&= ~0x80` of one function use `~0x80`**, including the first: uopt then holds `-129` in one register (the first site gets `andi 0xFF7F` and the dead `li v0,-129`, the others `and rd,rs,v0`) (NAME_ENT `func_8013B0A0`; with `0xFF7F` on the first the constant is missing).
6. **`u16` member stored with a `u8`/`s16` neighbour:** `*(s16 *)&rec[i].unk_0A = 0x80` after `rec[i].unk_08 = 0x80` shares the `li` (ETC `func_80142A4C`); a chain assignment reloads the halfword.
7. **Stack buffers.** Strings built with `func_800AE0F0(buf, ..); strcat(buf, ..)` need the sibling's frame: `s32 pad` (FAKE) before `u8 buf[0x100]` gives sp+0x34, `buf[0x108]` without pad gives frame 0x140 and sp+0x38 (NAME_ENT `func_8013E59C`, `func_8013F5B0`, `func_8013FCBC`).
8. **An empty literal is a rodata word of zeros**: `func_80036884("")` and `func_8006612C("")` for the `.word 0` pieces (EVENT `func_8010B970`, GEKO `func_8013E828`); do not declare a `D_801...` extern for a piece that sits in the object's own rodata (undefined at link time).
9. **Check GameState offsets by address**: `D_800E7208` is `unk_F88`, not `unk_F80`. `funcdiff.py` prints the mismatch as `lw 0(v0)` against `lw 3968(v0)`; the sha1 line of `ninja` is the final word (OLH `func_80135190` was wrong by 8 bytes until the build said so).
10. **Not C-compilable / blocked**: TACO `func_801420DC`, `func_801421AC` are gcc-shaped (constants in `$a0/$a1`, `nop` after `beq`), like `func_8015D270`. TT `func_80148B6C`, `func_80148C04` need the s16 parameter conversion at entry (K&R callee `func_80148974` is defined with a prototype in the same file). The T-0018 rows added by this list are marked T-9170 in [[data/t0018-cases]].
## Wave 6, list 1 (T-9110): 29 functions, 6,688 bytes, 37 files
Ticket [[tickets/T-9110-wave-6-list-1]]. List 1 held the leftovers of wave 5 (151 functions, mostly near misses); 29 matched, 31 more rows went to [[data/t0018-cases]]. New idioms, each checked in a build:
- **One-word struct copy gives `lw at / sw at`.** `*(TtVec1 *)(p + 0x20) = *(TtVec1 *)(arg0 + 0x20);` with `typedef struct { s32 w; } TtVec1;` compiles to the original's `lw $at,..; sw $at,..` pairs that the scheduler then interleaves with other stores (TT `func_8013BF9C`). Four plain `*(s32 *)` copies use `t6..t9`. A 16-byte struct copy uses `$at` for the first word only.
- **Compiler temporaries are not locals.** `0x801E8000 - (arg0 << 15)` written three times (no `off` variable) gives the spill slot at `sp+0x2C` that the original has; a declared `off` lands at `sp+0x28` (ETC `func_801436E4`).
- **Falling off the end of a switch returns the selector temporary.** `s32 f(void) { switch (...) { case 0: g(); break; ... } }` with no return gives `or v0,v1,zero` in the first delay slot and returns the callee's `$v0` from the arms (ETC `func_80147F7C`); with `return f();` arms and no default the same (RPG_BAT `func_80144B7C`, `func_80142000`, `func_801535E4`: `s32` plus bare `return;`). Callees that are `void` in the header are fine. A callee defined `void` later in the same file but called earlier needs a prototype in the overlay header (EVENT, TAIIKU, TEL).
- **`if (D++ >= k)` plus `s32` and no return** gives `lw; sltiu; xori; addiu; sw` (GEKO `func_8013BDB0`, the old `D += 1; if (D >= k)` form does not).
- **Pointer parameter.** `u8 *arg0` with `p = arg0 + 4` gives `addiu s3,a0,4` where `s32 arg0` gives `addiu a0,a0,4; move s3,a0` (`initModelingData_init`, prologue only).
- **Addresses of another overlay are absolute literals.** A load from an address outside the object (`D_801DA754`, `D_801D24B4` in SHOUGATU `func_80141780/50`) is `*(s16 *)0x801DA754`: IDO then emits `lui t9; lh t0,%lo(t9)` with the value in a new register, as the original; an `extern` or array view puts both in `$t9`. Same shape as KANGEI `func_80135634`. It does not work for main-exe addresses (`0x800B593C` becomes `lui; ori`).
- **Array view for load order.** `D_800EAFA0[0x8B] &= ..; D_800EAFA0[0xCF] &= ..` (one array, EVENT `func_800F8818`) keeps the second load after the first store, separate scalars hoist it.
- **Same-line scheduling trick** (as1 schedules per source line, T-7020): two statements on one line gave the original's `li` order (TT `func_8013BE08`, case 41), `p = D_801227A0; do {` on one line the original's `addiu` order (`initCoordinate`, permuter found it). Both carry a `FAKE` comment.
- **Matrix functions** (`func_800A09D0/0C64/0F4C`): `EtcMat m1, m2; EtcVec scale;` with two unused `s32[2]` pads (above `m1`, below `scale`) give frame 0x88 (ETC `func_801433E4`); without the second matrix 0x78 (TAIIKU `func_8013FEF0`, no pads needed). The translation words must be stored `t[0], t[1], t[2]` in source order to get the original's `lh` registers.
- **Loop stores `p[0x42 + i * 0x14] = 0` over 24 records** unroll as the original (`sb -0xE(v0)` is element -1 of the next trip). Declaring `p` before `i` decides the spill slot (TT `func_8013A960`).
- **Stack arrays plus a pad**: three words above the arrays are `i`, `r` and one `s32 pad[1]` (OLH `func_80133C4C`: eight `s16` x/y/w/h entries filled in a loop, a call per entry).
- **Pointer table loop** `p != D_80122CA0` needs `D_80122CA0` declared as its own symbol (end of `D_801227A0[16]`, now in `main_api.h` with `TaiikuBig`).
- **Empty string `""`** is the first rodata word of the object (`func_80036884("")`, `func_8006612C("")`); EVENT scene inits (`func_800F788C`, `func_800FE138`) match with `D_800B0A04[k].unk_06 += n` for the `s16` at record `k` (stride 0x34).

Found but not matched (rows in [[data/t0018-cases]]): K&R definition with two 4-byte struct parameters read with `lh` from the home slots plus FAKE pads (TACO `func_8013E424`, only the load grouping differs); constants shared in `$v0` across two byte stores in scene inits (GEKO `func_8013C200/C090`, EVENT `func_800FD820/D974`: IDO `t6/t7`); constant array index kept in a register (`_sys_default_tpage_set`, ETC `func_80146AC0`); `li k; multu` strides (GYOZI `func_80134658`, ETC `func_80143968`); hoisted `lui v1` with the value in `$v0` for main-exe data (DATE `func_801511B4`); shared `lui $at` outside the object's data range (TAIIKU `func_8013A63C`, `func_8013C4E4`).
## Wave 6, list 2 (T-9120)
Ticket [[tickets/T-9120-wave-6-list-2]]. 39 functions matched (4267 -> 4306): RPG_BAT 23, OLH 6, DATE 2, NAME_ENT 2, GYOZI 1, main 1, ETC 1, SHOUGATU 1, TACO 1, VALEN 1. Templates first, odd shapes second; the failures are rows in [[data/t0018-cases]].
- **RPG_BAT dialogue-script pages** (`func_80137280` family, 20 functions plus the shorter state machines around them): `s32 f(void) { switch (D_8015ED8C[0]) { case 0: func_800AE0F0(D_8015E828, "..."); [more lines into D_8015E850/E878/EA08..]; func_8014B738(D_8015E8F0, n, k); D_8015ED8C[0] += 1; return; case 1: func_8013F1C4(a, b, 0); ...; return; case 2: func_8013F250(1); return; ... last: func_8013F220(); func_8014EF3C(); return; } }`. Take the m2c draft and change four things: the `s32` return type without a value (T-8080 comment, the header prototype becomes `s32`), `*D_8015ED8C` to `D_8015ED8C[0]`, the missing third argument of `func_8014B738` (m2c counts two; the value is the `addiu a2` in the `jal` delay slot), and `/* fallthrough */ default: return;` to a plain `return;`. m2c writes `\x8f\\` for a Shift-JIS second byte `5C` (write the real character, e.g. the kanji for ten); jump tables compile in place and the sha1 line decides (funcdiff shows only table noise). The nested `switch` with a selector reload (`func_80138170`, `func_80157CCC`) keeps the `$v1`/`$v0` gap.
- **OLH help pages** (`func_801333E4` and five more): `s32 f(void)` with `switch (D_800E6280.unk_110D)` like the matched `func_801332F8`; the header prototype changes from `void` to `s32` (without it the `move v0,v1` is missing).
- **`(u8)` around a masked call result** (`DATE func_80156D60`): `if ((u8)(func_80051A68(6) & 0x7F) < 2)` gives the original's temporary numbering; `(u32)(...)` and the bare form shift every later temporary by one. The permuter found it as `& 0xFFu`.
- **Two statements, two ops** (`RPG_BAT func_8015906C`): `D |= 0x400000; D &= ~0x200000;` keeps the load in the register the original uses, `D = (D | a) & b` does not.
- **Bit-field flag store on the GameState record flag word** (`SHOUGATU func_8013AB5C`): `D_800E6280.unk_1BC[D_800E6280.unk_F5F].unk_0C.f.b2 = 1;` for what m2c prints as `.b[0] |= 4`; also GYOZI `((GyoziBit3 *)&D_800F53A0.girl[10].unk_10[0])->f = 1` for `D_800F5788 |= 8` (bit 3 of a girl flag byte, `lui t7; lbu t8,lo(t7)`).
- **Local function-pointer table with a bigger frame** (`DATE func_80154E48`, 42 pointers): `s32 idx; FnTbl42 tbl;` with `idx` declared first and used (`idx = D_800E6280.unk_110A; tbl.f[idx](0x80);` after the range test that reads the field directly). With an unused extra slot instead (`s32 pad[2]` before the table) the frame matches too (`DATE func_80155004`, still open for registers).
- **Argument order of stores around an `lbu`** (`NAME_ENT func_80137B84`): `p[0xC] = q[0]; p[0xD] = q[1]; *(s16 *)(p + 0x12) = 0x10; *(s16 *)(p + 0x10) = 0x10;` puts the second `lbu` before the two `sh` as the original does, with the constant shared with the next call's `a0` (no chain; a chain through a pointer reloads the first store).
- **Data island of main 80043510** (T-9010): `u8 D_800B3D54[12] = { 0 };` defines the pair that `func_8004482C` stores through one `lui $at`; the other neighbours of that function keep separate `lui` (symbols, not the file's data) and were defined as `s32/u8 ... = 0;` in place. The remaining island lines stay `INCLUDE_RODATA`.
- **Loop header on one line** fixes the order of the loop initialisations in the preheader (TACO `func_80152110`: `for (i = 0, j = arg0, p = &T[arg1]; i != 0x15; i += 3, j += 3, p++) f(j, *p, 1, 0, 0);` gives `s0 = i, s1 = j, s2 = p` like the original; separate init statements or a body with the increments give another assignment of the saved registers). Both TACO loops that call a 5-argument function still differ in one place: the original puts the stack-argument store `sw x,16(sp)` in the `jal` delay slot, IDO puts the last register argument there (`func_80152110`, `func_8014927C`; the matched `func_8014BE14` has the same call with a computed first argument).
- **Not C-matchable:** TACO `func_8015CF30` is the libgte `RotMatrixZ` in hand-scheduled assembly (`nop` after every `mflo`, `addu rd,rs,$zero`); same family as the three rotation helpers of the wave-5 notes.
- **Open, by cause** (rows in [[data/t0018-cases]]): the `$v1`-for-`$v0` selector and local (`func_8013A2F4`, `func_80138170`, `func_80157CCC`, `func_801347E0` with `a0` for the reloaded byte), constants numbered in another order (`TT func_8014D168`, `func_80134ADC`), the `multu a1,a0` with `a0 = 0x38` of GYOZI `func_80136124` and SHOUGATU `func_80134730`, the `% 2` fix-up of DATE2 `func_80136A90`, `lui at`/`addiu a0` order of a GameState member passed through `*(u8 *)&` (SHUGAKU `func_80135630`), zero kept in `$a0` (TT `func_8014C5F8`).
## Wave 6, list 4 (T-9140): 28 functions matched
Ticket [[tickets/T-9140-wave-6-list-4]]. Worktree w6-4. 28 functions (7,804 bytes): GYOZI `func_8013B43C`; main `strSync`, `func_8007B8F8`, `func_8007B734`, `func_8007BF04`, `func_80056284`, `func_80054AF4`; OLH `func_80132744`, `func_80132954`, `func_80132BD4`, `func_80132CDC`, `func_80132E54`, `func_801348F4`, `func_801349FC`, `func_80134D14`, `func_80134E00`, `func_80136804`, `func_80136BD0`, `func_80136CF4`, `func_80136E18`; DATE2 `func_80132C60`; EVENT `func_8010A7E0`, `func_8010AAF8`; RPG_BAT `func_8014E1A4`, `func_8013D0D4`; BUNKA_SD `func_80132000`; ENDING `func_8013B9F0`; BUNKASAI `func_8013FD90`. 22 new rows in [[data/t0018-cases]]. Idioms (all measured with IDO 5.3 in the build pipeline):
1. **The splat data symbols D_8012xxxx/D_800E7Dxx are separate objects of the original, not array elements.** `func_8007B8F8`/`func_8007B734` (main 80079B10) write `D_80125D64 = ...; D_80125D84 = ...` as scalars: one `lui $at` per store; declaring them as `D_80125D80[]` elements gives a shared `lui at` and fails. Add the scalar `extern`s to `main_api.h` next to the array (the array stays for the code that walks it).
2. **Constants that are sums in the original are `D + literal`, not locals.** `D_80125D84 = D_80125D80[0] + 0x10000; D_80125D88 = D_80125D84 + 0x28000;` (statements in ascending order, then the `sw` of the plain constants) gives `addu v1,v0,a1` with `a1 = 0x10000` shared with the store of 0x10000. Locals (`a = 0x1010; b = a + 0x10000`) are folded by uopt; `D_80125D84 = D_80125D80[0] + D_80125D90` (global operand) reorders the `lui`s.
3. **A read-modify-write that comes first in the C is stored last.** `D_80125D10.unk_00 &= ~0x400; D_80125D10.unk_00 &= ~0x4000; D_80125D14 &= ...` before the zero stores of other scalars gives loads first, `and`s next and the stores of the RMW at the end (as1 sinks them); written after the stores the loads sink too. Two `&=` statements keep the two `and` instructions (`& ~0x400 & ~0x4000` in one expression is folded). `func_8007A868` (same area) stayed open: the original computes the `and`s after the last zero store but loads early; 28 statement orders and the permuter did not reproduce it.
4. **`strSync` (T-1330's permuter result) is plain C**: `u32 strSync(...)` without a `return` (implicit-int shape of T-9000). `volatile s32 timeout` stays.
5. **Counted loop over a small table needs the right base symbol.** `func_80056284` clears three 4-byte records at `D_800E7D17..`; `for (i...) D_800E7D13[i*4+5], [i*4+6], [i*4+7], [i*4+4] = 0` (base `D_800E7D13`, not `D_800E7D11 + 2`) gives the original's `addiu v0,4` + offsets 1,2,3,0 pointer walk. IDO picks the induction base from the constant part of the index, so the symbol that the original used matters: `D_800E7D13` is added to `config/symbol_addrs_main.txt` (main only; in `symbol_addrs.txt` splat of every overlay complains "unable to determine a segment"). One store (`D_800E7D16 = 0`) has to sit in the `for` init to land after the loop prologue: `FAKE`.
6. **Retry loops `while (fd == -1) { i++; if (i > max) return 0; fd = open(...); D = fd; }`** (main `func_80054AF4`; `max` from `arg0 != 0 ? 8 : 0x10`) match with a `u8 name[0x1C]` local: the frame (0x60) says the name buffer is 0x1C bytes, not the 0x24-byte `FileReq`. The same shape does not match for `func_80054704` (`$s1`/`$s2` swapped) and `func_8005478C` (IDO forwards the stored `D_800B58E4` into `$a0`, turns the 16-trip loop into `bne s0,s3`).
7. **OLH help pages and other text pages are one template.** `s32 f(void) { switch (D_800E6280.unk_110D) { case 0: func_8004EAAC(); func_8004E788(-0x88, y, c, str, 0) ...; unk_110D += 1; return; case 1: func_80052000(); return; case 2: func_80042940(0); return; } }` (`return` without value in an `s32` function), header prototype `void` -> `s32`. 13 OLH functions matched mechanically from m2c (strings: m2c writes `\x83\\` for `ソ`, `\x95\\` for `表`: second byte 0x5C; decode as cp932). The scratch generator is not committed.
8. **Hidden call arguments**: `m2c.py` takes the argument count from the callee's asm, which can be too small (RPG_BAT `func_8014B738` takes 3: `li a2,0x8C` in the delay slot). A single missing `li` in a delay slot is the first thing to check when a draft is one instruction off.
9. **Chain assignment order** (`x = y = z = k` on array elements): the innermost target (rightmost) is stored last, the others right to left, so `D_801217D0[61].unk_0A = D_801217D0[62].unk_0A = D_801217D0[63].unk_0A = 0x70;` stores 62, 61, 63 (ENDING `func_8013B9F0`).
10. **A load is not moved over a store through the same symbol, and a store/load pair of two scalars is treated as two symbols**: BUNKASAI `func_8013FD90` stores `D_80122EBC = 0xA` and then switches on `D_80122EB8`; the original loads the selector after the store, IDO hoists it above. `(&D_80122EB8)[1] = 0xA` (one symbol) reproduces the order (`FAKE`: the real source has one object, as in the sibling `D_80145048`-style tables).
11. **`s16` parameters and compare operand order**: `void func_8007BF04(s16 arg0)` (ANSI, header changed from `s32`) and `arg0 == D_80125D4C` (global on the right) match; the other order swaps the `bne` operands.
12. **Own-data blocks (T-9010), TAIIKU `func_801368B8`**: 17 increments of `D_8014920C..D_80149290` match everything (shared `lui at` per group, every load behind the earlier stores) when the whole block is defined once in the file as one struct (`TkData`), and fail in the same two places with several smaller objects: loads of the next group hoist over the previous group's stores when the objects differ. One swap is left (`lui t4` of the next group above the `sw` of `D_80149224`), so the function stays asm; the experiment shows that "loads stay behind stores" is a property of the object, not of the symbol names.
Open (all in [[data/t0018-cases]]): `func_80149F48`, `func_8014494C`, `strSetDefDecEnv`, `func_80136B18`, `func_8007A868`, `func_80055A38` (everything but the induction registers of `D_80123120` and `D_80123324`), `func_80142AF0`, `func_80137228`, `func_801368B8`, `func_801328D0`, `func_80149EA0`, `func_80054704`, `func_8005478C`, `func_80144B44`, `func_8014BF2C`, `func_80145FB0`, `func_8007BCFC`, `func_801518B8` (one temp), `func_80146BCC`, `func_801355E8`, `func_80149400`, `func_80145378`. Not tried again (rows from earlier waves, same shapes): the `idx * 0x38` `multu` family (GEKO `func_801374A8`, GYOZI `func_80144A74`, `func_801455BC`, SHUGAKU `func_8013ABAC`), the TACO ring buffers, the NAME_ENT twins.
Tooling notes: (a) after a function goes from C back to `INCLUDE_ASM`, or the other way, `asm/**/matchings/` and `asm/**/nonmatchings/` hold the same `.s` twice and `funcdiff.py` fails with "symbol already defined"; deleting the stale copy (matchings if the source has `INCLUDE_ASM`, nonmatchings if the function is C) fixes it, `rm -rf asm` plus configure also. (b) `funcdiff.py` prints the line that moved, not the line that is out of order: an instruction swap can show as a single `sw` difference with the wrong offset; compare with `objdump` when the listing looks too small. (c) `m2c.py` takes the alphabetically first overlay that has the function name; always pass `--unit`.
## Wave 6, list 6 (T-9160): 20 functions matched, 35 T-0018 rows added
Ticket [[tickets/T-9160-wave-6-list-6]]. New patterns (the rest of the near misses went into [[data/t0018-cases]]):
- **Owned data is the cure for `$v1` where the original has `$v0`.** After `tools/data_island.py` and a C definition of the variable (`s32 D_8013E730 = 0;`, OPTION `func_80139F04`; `s32 D_80139B24 = 0;`, EN_NICHI `func_80132ADC`), the function that was one register off matches. Write the owned variable directly in every statement (`D += 1; if (D >= 0x36) D = 0;`), not through a local copy: a local copy gives the old `$v1`/`$a1` allocation. A piece that is larger than the variable (16 bytes for one `s32`) needs one definition per unreferenced word (`D_8013E734` ..), otherwise the object's `.data` shrinks and the sha1 fails.
- **`if (v == 0) .. else if (v == 0x1B) ..` on an owned counter, with the `0x1B` block out of line after the `jr`, is a one-statement `switch`** (`case 0: ..; break; case 0x1B: ..; break;`), EN_NICHI `func_80132ADC`. Every if/else and early-return spelling gave the in-line layout.
- **A 4-record table at `D_8014A13C` (stride 0x24) is one C object**: TAIIKU `func_80143AC8` (`for (i = 0; i < 4; i++)` over four fields, unrolled by IDO) only gets the original's shared `lui $at` after `u8 D_8014A13C[0x90] = { 0 };` replaces the 37 `INCLUDE_RODATA` pieces `D_8014A13C..D_8014A1C8`. Defining each piece as its own variable does not share the `lui` (as1 shares only the same symbol plus offset). The same file's `func_80144768`, `func_801448D4` and `func_80144C70` (local `Tri3`/`Tri3S` tables, `s32 i` declared before the table, byte pointers `q += 0x44`, `r = D_8014A13C + i * 0x24`) match with the existing byte-array style; `*(s32 *)(r + 0x30) += *(s32 *)(r + 0x2C)` keeps the load order of `v = *(r+0x30) += *(r+0x2C)`.
- **funcdiff and stale asm.** After a function turns from `INCLUDE_ASM` to C, `asm/.../nonmatchings/` still holds its `.s` until `rm -rf asm` and `configure.py`; funcdiff then fails with "symbol already defined" while building its reference object. The same stale tree makes a later `git checkout` of the C file leave `Cannot open file GLOBAL_ASM:...` errors; run `rm -rf asm; python3 configure.py` after reverting.
- **String arguments that are empty strings are the rodata word `""`.** EVENT `func_801016BC` calls `func_80036884("")`; declaring the string as `extern u8 D_8011F81C[]` links against a symbol that exists in no linker script. Look at what other overlays pass (`""`) before inventing an extern. Same in GEKO `func_8013D9C4` (`func_8006612C("")`).
- **`func_80084D3C(0x38)` in the m2c draft was `func_80084D3C()`**: the `0x38` is a constant the function keeps in `$a0` for a multiply in an earlier block (SHOUGATU `func_80132E8C`); the `nop` in the `jal` slot is the evidence.
- **A prototype is not always the cause of `andi` before a call.** `func_80083440(u8)` makes IDO narrow the argument; the original called it with a plain `move a0,v0`. A file-level `#define MAIN_API_OVERRIDE_func_80083440` plus `void func_80083440(s32);` (as KANGEI/DATE do in their headers) matched SHOUGATU `func_80136BD4`.
- **TACO `TcPos` frames again.** `func_801571E8`/`func_801572D8` match with `TcPos p0; TcPos a; TcPos b;` (p0 only supplies the frame slot) and the three stores of `a` on one source line: as1 schedules the stores of one line together (`FAKE` comment in the source). The `(i + D_8015EDB4)->` spelling (index first) gives the original's `addu v0,idx,base` operand order, `D_8015EDB4[i]` the other.
- **Dispatch on a GameState byte with five cases is the usual `s32`-less void function** (`week_day`): no change from [[decompile-workflow]]; its two callees `week_day_main`/`week_day_exit` are defined later in the same file, so the file forward-declares them (not in `main_api.h`; `check_headers.py` accepts it).
Left open and why (details per row in [[data/t0018-cases]]): about half of the failures are the `$v0`/`$v1` first-global load of a GameState or other main-exe symbol (OPTION `func_80139878`, `func_80139F8C`, TAIIKU `func_8014430C`, RPG_BAT `func_80142544`, KANGEI `func_80136970`, `func_80136BF4`), seven are loops with a pointer or constant hoisted into `$s`/`$a` registers that IDO does not hoist (TT `func_80145370`, TAIIKU `func_801449A0`, OPTION `func_80138C20`/`func_80138DF8` with the swapped `$s0`/`$s1`), and two are `bne` operand order.

## Wave-6 codegen shapes (T-9210)
Ticket [[tickets/T-9210-wave-6-codegen-shapes]]. Six shapes left open by wave 6, each checked with the build's IDO 5.3 pipeline (scratch compiles with `cc -S` to see uopt's output before as1). Four have a plain C form, none needed a build step. How-to summary: [[decompile-workflow]], "Wave-6 codegen shapes".
1. **Constant multiplies that reuse the loaded constant** (`li a0,56; multu`, list 4; `li k; multu` strides, list 1). `check_para_limit` (`func_80084D3C`) reads no argument: its asm overwrites `$a0` before reading it, and of its 118 call sites in the original only 21 have `0x38` in `$a0` (the rest hold whatever the caller left there). So `func_80084D3C(0x38)` in the m2c drafts, and the `sizeof(Rec38)`/`0x38U` arguments of earlier matches, are the multiplier of a record index that happens to sit in `$a0`; GYOZI `func_8008FB00` is the same. With `func_80084D3C();` every earlier match still builds the same bytes (DATE `func_8013F544`, `func_8013A898`, DATE2 `func_8013775C` loses its `FAKE`, SHOUGATU `func_80142784`, SHUGAKU `func_80135DB8`). IDO puts the 0x38 in a register (`li; multu`) instead of shifts when there are two or more products, and there are two products only when the index is loaded again after the first record store: the index must be a member of the same object as the records. Main: `D_800E6280.unk_1BC[D_800E6280.unk_F5F]` (the scalar `D_800E71DF` is not reloaded). GYOZI: `D_800F62CF` is byte 0xF2F of the GYOZI work area `D_800F53A0` (`GyoziWork.unk_F2F`, added), `D_800F53A0.girl[D_800F53A0.unk_F2F]`. Matched: GEKO `func_801374A8`, GYOZI `func_80137BEC`, `func_80134D9C`, `func_80144A74`, SHUGAKU `func_801350F4`. Not reproduced: the index loaded once and the product computed twice (SHOUGATU `func_80134730`, GYOZI `func_80136124`: index in `D_80122CDC`/`D_8012E66C`, separate objects). IDO merges the two products for a direct load in every form tried (local copy, re-assignment, pointer local, `GameState *g`); it gives exactly the original's shape only when the index is an indirect load from the stored object, which is not plausible source. 
2. **Stack argument in the `jal` delay slot** (TACO `func_80152110`, `func_8014927C`). uopt marks a load through a strength-reduced array index as not aliasing the stack (`.noalias $17,$sp` in the `cc -S` output); a load through a pointer local gets no such mark. as1 then may not move the stack-argument store `sw x,0x10(sp)` above the argument load, fills the load delay with it and puts the last register move in the `jal` slot. Writing the loop over the array index (`D_801603F0[arg1]` with `arg1++`; `D_8015FCA8[i]`) gives the original's slot. Matched both.
3. **Loop-invariant values in `$s`/`$a` registers** (TT `func_80145370`, TAIIKU `func_801449A0`, T-7020 phantom registers). IDO hoists the same loads and constants (TAIIKU: `lh D_8014A1CE`, `&D_8014A120`, 1, 3, 0xA4 into `$a3`, `$s0`-`$s3`, all reproduced). What differed was a load the original does NOT hoist: `D_801207CA` is a field of the `D_8011ECD0` record table that the loop stores to, and read through the table base (`*(s16 *)&D_8011ECD0[0x1AFA]`) it is reloaded each pass as in the original; the stride-8 term is `i * 8 + 8`, not a separate counter. TAIIKU `func_801449A0` is then 17 lines off (a reload after the `D_8014A120[n]` store, which suggests `D_8014A120`..`D_8014A1CB` is one object with the table, and the strlen pointer register); the draft is behind `NON_MATCHING` in `src/ovl/TAIIKU/80142240.c`. TT `func_80145370` (constants in `$a2/$a3` against IDO's `$a0/$a1`): unused parameters (ANSI or K&R) are spilled and do not move the constants; separate pointer/counter variables per loop make it worse. No C form found.
4. **Narrow K&R parameter home slots** (TT `func_80148B6C`, `func_80148C04`). The functions and their callee `func_80148974` are old-style definitions: `void func_80148B6C(x, y, v, n)` with `s16 x; s16 y; u32 v; u8 n;`. cfe converts the `s16` parameters in place at entry, keeps an assigned `u8` parameter in its home slot (`sw a3,0x54(sp); lbu; sb`), and passes `s16` values on raw to an old-style callee. The buffer offset comes from the promoted locals declared before it (`u8 *p; s32 i; u32 d; u8 buf[12];`: sp+0x30, not 0x3C). Matched with their siblings: TT `func_80148A04`, `func_80148B6C`, `func_80148C04`, `func_80148C94` (the T-7000 "buffer 12 bytes lower" row), and `func_80148974` rewritten old-style. Tooling: `tools/check_headers.py` read the parameter declarations of an old-style definition as file-level declarations and reported conflicts between two such functions; fixed with a test (`test_kr_parameter_declarations_are_not_globals`). A sweep of the asm for home-slot reloads of narrow parameters lists 35 more functions (main `load_tpage_buf_lock` comes within the argument copies with an old-style definition).
5. **One `li v0,k` shared by two byte stores in scene inits** (GEKO `func_8013C200`/`func_8013C090`, EVENT `func_800FD820`/`func_800FD974`). A chain assignment over two GameState (or EVENT) bytes written as element stores, `(&D_800E6280.unk_F5F)[0] = (&D_800E6280.unk_75D)[0] = 0xC;`, keeps one `$v0` (the T-9150 rule for scalars: IDO forwards a chain value only to indirect stores). Matched all four.
6. **Return value in `$v1` against `$v0`** (DATE `func_801551D0`, `func_8014E38C`, RPG_BAT `func_8013F350`). Tried: `++D < k` with `s32` and no return, a separate increment, the word view, the global written directly instead of a local (RPG_BAT; also with the variable defined in the file): IDO keeps the same choice. No C form found beyond the T-9160 own-data rule.

## Wave 7, list 5 (T-9350): 16 functions matched, 20 T-0018 rows added
Matched: EVENT `func_800FD588`; NAME_ENT `func_80133E54`, `func_80133FC4`, `func_80137AA0`; main `func_8005C7FC`, `func_8005D1B0`; TACO `func_80155E10`; OLH `func_801324EC`, `func_801365AC`, `func_80132294`; BUNKA_SD `func_801362EC`; BUNKAKEN `func_80144D38`, `func_80144E9C`; RPG_BAT `func_8013673C`, `func_8015675C`, `func_8013FD8C`. What worked (all plain C unless noted):
- **`% N` on a main global read twice** (EVENT `func_800FD588`): the `D_800B1AE4 * 0` comparison from `func_800FCDD8` moves the load into `$v1` (FAKE, same as there).
- **Unrolled index loops that look like straight-line code** (NAME_ENT `func_80133E54`, `func_80133FC4`): five hit tests over `D_8014CCD0[i]` are a `for (i = 0; i < 5; i++)` (IDO peels the first trip and unrolls the other four from one `li a0,1`); the five flag bytes `D_80120B1B`, `D_8011ECD0[0x44 + 0x1E4B]` ... are `D_8011ECD0[i * 0x44 + 0x1E4B]` for i = 0..4 (the first one is `D_80120B1B` by address). Write the compare as `i == D_8014CCC8` (operand order of `bne`). For the hit test, read the other halfword into a local BEFORE the store to the result (`y = D_8011ECFA; D_8014CCCC = -1;`): the permuter found it, the reload otherwise lands in the wrong register.
- **Pointer loop with a separate counter** (main `func_8005C7FC`, `func_8005D1B0`): `for (i = 0, p = (u8 *)&D_800E7D10; i < 0xE; i++) { ...; p += 1; }` with a divisor variable `d = 5` (the original divides by a register, so `i / d`, `i % d`) and `func_80049A40` called as `void ();` through `MAIN_API_OVERRIDE_` (narrow prototype parameters otherwise). The init order inside the `for` header decides whether `ori s3` comes before `addiu s1` in the prologue.
- **Same-offset struct fields, two address forms** (TACO `func_80155E10`): in the same function `(arg0 + D_8015EDB4)->f` gives `addu o,D` and `(D_8015EDB4 + arg0)->f` gives `addu D,o`; mix them where the original does.
- **Four arrays plus a string table loop** (OLH `func_801324EC`, `func_801365AC`, BUNKAKEN `func_80144D38`): the `func_80133C4C` template (`s32 pad[]` above the arrays, `s16 a[8], b[8], c[8], d[8]`, index loop) matches unchanged; in BUNKAKEN the pad is two words and `a[i]` must be written before `b[i]` (it decides which array gets `$s1`).
- **Selector read twice** (BUNKA_SD `func_801362EC`): the first condition reads `unk_110A` into a temp (`$a1`) and the second re-reads the global; a callee that the original calls with no arguments (`func_801363BC()`) must be called with none, the stale `$a1` is not an argument.
- **Switch state machines** (RPG_BAT three functions): m2c's `return`s become `break`s; a flag byte that is stored as `0x82` is `u8` (`s8` gives `li -126`); for `D_8015ED98 &= ~0x1000` followed by a store to `D_8015ED9C` write `D_8015ED98 = D_8015ED98 & ~0x1000; D_8015ED9C = 0xFFFF;` (store order).
- **Call in a loop with two counters** (NAME_ENT `func_80137AA0`): four rolled loops `for (i = a, y = b; i < n; i++, y += 0x18)`; callees defined later in the same file need a forward declaration in the overlay header first.
Not matched (see [[data/t0018-cases]], 20 rows): the recurring blockers are temporary numbering (`func_8005B040`, `func_8005B2BC`), a variable in `$v0`/`$v1` against `$a0`/`$a1` (`func_80134110`, `func_8013987C`, `strSetDefDecEnv`), the phantom `$a0` (TT `func_80142570`) and store/load scheduling (`func_80132198`, `func_80138D40`, `join_club_select`). The permuter solves a case in one run when the difference is where a global is loaded (NAME_ENT `func_80133E54`); it did not move any of the register-number cases.

Ticket [[tickets/T-9340-wave-7-list-4]]. 9 of the 142 functions matched; the rest of the list is dominated by register-order rows (about 30 rows added to [[data/t0018-cases]]). What worked, with the function that showed it:
- **The permuter finds one-line tricks when a single instruction is off.** Run `permute.py ... all <func> --time 150 -j 4` and read the best `output-*/source.c` against `base.c`, not only its score (a score of 10 or 70 can be a stack-slot or one-register difference the candidate already fixed). - **Scene-script chains in ENDING** (`func_801380B0`, `func_80139498`) match when written like the already matched siblings: the D_8011F522 stores go through `*(s16 *)&D_8011ECD0[0x852]`, the `D_8011F4DE/E0/D0/CA` stores through their own symbols, the u8 `D_8013C364` compared as `(u8)D_8013C364`. `func_80137340` is the local function-pointer table idiom (`FnTbl6`, `s32 idx` first) in an `s32` function with an early `return 0`.
- **Scene init twins**: GYOZI `func_8013D294` follows `func_8013CF2C` (FAKE byte-typed store as the argument); the record index must be read as `D_800F53A0.unk_F2F` (member of the same object) for the last bit-field store, otherwise the index lands in `$a0` instead of `$t1`. TT `func_80145E60`: the last argument `a + 0x32 + k * 6` (not `a + k * 6 + 0x32`) gives `addu a0,s0,t5` in the original operand order.
- **Not matched, new patterns** (rows in [[data/t0018-cases]]): (1) ENDING scene scripts that end with the `% 240` / `D_8011F4DE` chunk (`func_80138278`, `func_80138FC8`, `func_801391E4`, `func_8013855C`, `func_80137BB4`): everything equal except every temporary is one number lower in the original, as in SHOUGATU `func_801347E0` (`andi t8` against `t7` after a `& 0x7F; < 2`); no source change found. (2) RPG_BAT `func_801495DC`: the original keeps three `sw D_8015EBB0` stores (join and the two nested tests), IDO removes the value-redundant ones. (3) Zeroing pointer loops (`*p++ = 0` up to the next symbol) get start `$v0`/end `$v1` where the original has the reverse (RPG_BAT `func_8014F540`, `func_8014F278`). (4) GPU packet appends (`func_8013D2E0`, `func_8013D3C0`): the original keeps `0xFFFFFF` in `$at` and the pointers in `$v1/$a1`. (5) `lwl` struct copies need a struct whose size is not a word multiple and an alignment-1 member type (`u8 s[3][9]`).
- **Tooling notes.** `git stash` is shared between all worktrees (one repository): never use it in a wave worktree (a `stash pop` brought another agent's stash into this one; `git reset --hard HEAD` after a pure-commit state undid it). `dupes.py --apply --files <stems>` matches stems across overlays (`80132000` is GEKO, OPTION and SHUGAKU): it edited `src/ovl/GEKO/80132000.c`, which this list does not own; check `git status` after every run.
## Wave 7, list 7 (T-9370): 19 functions matched, 6,780 bytes
Ticket [[tickets/T-9370-wave-7-list-7]]. Matched: SHUGAKU `func_801385A8`, TACO `func_801371B4`, `func_80136FBC`, `func_80148308`, `func_80151F94`, `func_80153068`, GYOZI `func_8013BDA0`, TT `func_80149D64`, `func_8014A198`, `func_8014A958`, EVENT `func_8010564C`, `func_80102AB0`, RPG_BAT `func_801359FC`, `func_80136374`, `func_80149AA8`, `func_8014A16C`, `func_80157CCC`, KANGEI `func_80133D28`, `func_80134374`. New or sharpened rules (the rest went into [[data/t0018-cases]]):
- **Stores in front of a pointer loop are the left-over copies of the unroll** (TACO `func_80148308`): two stores to `D_80127090` and `D_801270A0`, then a loop with `addiu v0,64` over 28 records, is one loop `for (i = 1; i < 0x1F; i++) D_80127080[i].unk0 = 0;` (30 trips = 2 left-over copies + 7 x 4). Do not write the head stores separately; the loop body goes on the `for` line so copy 0 comes first. The same function needs a write-back `D = t` before the call (`FAKE`): the counter is promoted and flushed in the `jal` delay slot.
- **Hoisted globals are locals, and three things order them** (TT `func_8014A958`, `func_8014A198`): `p = D_80158A74; q = D_80158A78;` at the top gives the original's two `lw` before the first compare. The assignment order is the load order; the declaration order is the stack slot of the one that is spilled across a call (the first declared sits on top); the variable with more uses gets the lower register (`q`, assigned again in each branch, took `$v0`). A pointer stored to a local before the branches and reloaded as `D_80158A78` inside them reproduces a global the original reloads.
- **Statement order is register numbering** (TT `func_8014A198`): the temporaries are numbered in source order and as1 then moves loads and constants up. Writing the second division before the two `s16` copies (not in the asm's order) gave `li t2,0x3600; lui t4` exactly.
- **A constant shared with a store: declare the loop counter unsigned** (TT `func_80149D64`): `do { i++; q += 0x60; q[-0x60] = 0; *(s32 *)(q - 0x28) = 0; } while (i != 2)` with `s32 i` shared the loop bound 2 with the `sh 2` store above it (`li a2,2` early); `u32 i` gives the separate `li a0,2` of the original (constants are kept in a register only for uses of one type, [[decompile-workflow]]).
- **`if (c) x = 1; else x = 0;` is the branch shape `bne; nop; b; li 1`** (GYOZI `func_8013BDA0`): the flag assignment from a compare with the zero in the else arm; `x = 0; if (c) x = 1;` gives a shorter sequence. The record index must be the GameState-style member (`D_800F53A0.unk_F2F`) in all three uses to keep `li a1,0x38; multu` (round-6 idiom 1).
- **Chain assignment and pointer-plus-index found by the permuter** (TACO `func_80151F94`): `*arg0 = *arg1 = 0;` (one `sb zero` pair) and `(D_8015EDB4 + idx)->unk84[1]` (index second) were the last two differences after the frame fix; `tools/permute.py` found both in 150 s. A near miss of two or three registers is worth one permuter run before it goes into the T-0018 table.
- **Frame padding is an unused ARRAY, not a scalar** (IDO drops an unused scalar; a one-word array is kept only between two used locals): TACO `func_80151F94` `s32 pad[15]` above `idx` (frame +56), `func_80153068` `pad[15]` above `idx` and `gap[1]` between `idx` and `r` (without `gap` `r` sits one word higher), BUNKAKEN `func_80152F4C` `pad[2]`, TACO `func_8013F250` `pad[2]`. T-3330 slot rule: the first declared sits on top. One free word at the edge, e.g. below a table (EVENT `func_800FD00C`, KANGEI `func_80135004`'s RECT), has no spelling.
- **One symbol for neighbouring globals restores the original load order** (EVENT `func_80102AB0`): `D_800B0B0E += 1; D_800B0B20 -= 1;` as two scalars lets as1 hoist the second `lh` above the first `sh`; `D_800B0B0E[0] += 1; D_800B0B0E[9] -= 1;` (`extern s16 D_800B0B0E[]`) keeps the order (same rule as BUNKASAI `func_8013FD90`, note 10 above).
- **`""` is the 4-byte rodata word before the next string** (EVENT `func_80102AB0`: `func_80036884("")`, then `"廊下"`).
- **Jump-table dispatchers and the KANGEI scene inits are mechanical from m2c** (RPG_BAT `func_801359FC`, `func_80136374`, `func_8014A16C`: `switch (D_8015EDB0.unk_00)` with `break`, no `return`; `func_80149AA8`: nested switch whose inner table has `case 0: default:` on the first block and a separate identical `case 1:` block, because the table has six entries). KANGEI `func_80133D28`/`func_80134374`: `for (i = 0; i < 0xB; i++)` over `D_800E6280.unk_1BC[i]` with `s16 i`, bit 1 of the flag word is `unk_0C.f.b1`, and an addition of two halfwords is written in the order the original loads them (`D_800E666E + D_800E6672`, swapped from m2c).
- **`^ 0` on a call result is the switch-temporary copy the original has** (RPG_BAT `func_80157CCC`, `FAKE`): the `s32` function without return gives the outer `or v0,v1,zero`, the inner switch on a stored call result needs `D_8015ED38 = func_8013E9A8(6) ^ 0;` (found by the permuter; its "NOT A MATCH" verdict was only reformatted declarations, the function itself matched).
- **`FileReq` explains main `func_80054704`** (`sp5C` = `req.retry`, the uninitialised counter that is stored back on success); `func_8005478C` has the same buffer. Not matched, see the rows in [[data/t0018-cases]].
Blocked and why (all in [[data/t0018-cases]]): constants in higher registers than IDO picks (TT `func_8014A814`, `func_80149108`), `$a0`/`$t` index order (GYOZI `func_8013D764`, RPG_BAT `func_8014AB84`), selector register copies (ETC `func_801421AC`), global-in-register promotion (RPG_BAT `func_801453B4`, TACO `func_801522B0`), operand order of `bne` (GYOZI `func_80135518`), address CSE across two loops (BUNKA_SD `func_80134418`, TACO `func_8013DDE4`), unit-private frame word (EVENT `func_800FD00C`, KANGEI `func_80135004`) and one tooling gap: TACO `func_8013F250` matches in C but its strings "SCORE"/"TIME" live in the orphan rodata chunk `8015DA90` (second chunk of object 8013DB80), so C literals shift every later address by 16 bytes.

Ticket [[tickets/T-9310-wave-7-list-1]]. Worktree w7-1, 34 files. The list held the leftovers of waves 5 and 6 (most of the top scores were known near misses); 34 of 153 matched (4558 -> 4592), the rest went to [[data/t0018-cases]] or stayed untried. Matched: main `get_weekly_bg_sector`, `menu_check`, `func_8005352C`, `func_80074F24`; EVENT `func_800F7AA8`, `func_800F7C94`, `func_800F8590`, `func_800F8878`, `func_800F8C2C`, `func_800F9558`; DATE `func_80151F84`, `func_80152684`; DATE2 `func_80136BA4`; GEKO `func_801339AC`, `func_8013CD18`; OLH `func_8013306C`, `func_8013500C`; OPTION `func_8013A604`, `func_8013AD94`, `func_8013B410`, `func_8013BECC`, `func_8013C404`, `func_8013C52C`; RPG_BAT `func_801426B0`, `func_80142A30`; SHUGAKU `func_80134F18`; TACO `func_801570A4`, `func_801573C8`, `func_80157AE0`, `func_8015800C`, `func_80158F48`; TAIIKU `func_8013C694`, `func_801404DC`; TT `func_8013ED70`. New idioms, each checked with a build:
- **Write the globals, not m2c's locals.** m2c turns `D_x` into `temp_*` locals; IDO then allocates them as variables (`$a1`, `$t6`, a second `$v0`). Writing the global itself again in every statement lets uopt promote it as the original did: TAIIKU `func_8013C694` (the m2c draft with six `s16`/`s32` locals missed in the registers of the first block; the same code with `(D_80149984 >> 3) - 0x50` spelled out each time matches), EVENT `func_800F8590`/`func_800F8878` (`D_801207AC += 1; if (D_801207AC >= 4) D_801207AC = 0; f(.., D_801207AC)` gives one `lh`, one conversion `sll/sra` and one `sh`; a local `s16 v` gave two conversions and an extra move).
- **Raw local plus repeated derived expression.** `u16 x = D_800E6280.unk_0F4.h; if ((x >> 0xC) >= 6 && (x >> 0xC) < 0xB)` (main `func_8005352C`) puts the raw value in `$v0` and the shift in `$v1`, as the original; a local for the shifted value, or the global written twice, puts the shift in `$t6`. Same in `get_weekly_bg_sector` (`u8 x = unk_71C;` then `unk_69C[x].unk_01` twice), GEKO `func_801339AC` (`u16 raw; (raw >> 0xC) == 6 .. == 7`) and main `menu_check` (`u8 x = D_800E6280.unk_1092; (x & 3) == 0 .. == 1 .. == 3`: an `if` chain, a `switch` there builds a jump table). It decides which of the two values gets the variable register, nothing else.
- **A 4x4 pointer loop with sixteen stores is a 16-trip array loop IDO unrolled by four.** OPTION menu pages (`func_8013C404`, `func_8013B410`, `func_8013BECC`, `func_8013AD94`, `func_8013A604`): `for (i = 0; i < 16; i++) { a[i] = 0x20; b[i] = i * 0xC - 0x60; c[i] = 0x10; d[i] = 0xC; }` gives the four pointer inductions, the four running values and the three hoisted constants of the original, with the original's register order. The nested `i`/`j` form has the same shape but the opposite register order. One `s32 pad[1]` above the arrays fixes their offsets (`FAKE`). The tails are the OLH page template (`func_8004E788` string lines).
- **Menu pages with `s16 a[8], b[8], c[8], d[8]`** (OLH `func_8013306C`, `func_8013500C`): the loop is the wave-6 template; the zero stores of single entries are a chain `c[4] = c[5] = c[6] = 0;` that stores `c[5], c[4], c[6]` (the permuter found it, a plain run of three assignments puts the third in the wrong place). Frame and array offsets need unused words above (and, in `func_8013306C`, below) the arrays: try `x` above in 0..3 and `y` below in 0..3 with a scratch script, it takes one build per pair.
- **A chain of three byte fields written through `(&F)[0] = (&F)[1] = (&F)[2] = 0x80`** keeps the constant in one register (OPTION `func_8013A604`: `unk_036`, `unk_037`, `unk_038` stored `37, 36, 38`); plain member assignments reload it.
- **One object where the original has several symbols.** The loads of a function stay behind the stores of the same function when every access goes through one array or struct: RPG_BAT `func_80142A30` reads `D_8015EC28/2C/EBAC` and stores `D_8015EC50/54`, written `(&D_8015EBAC)[41] = (&D_8015EBAC)[31] - 0xF0;` (the plain scalars hoist the loads, `FAKE`); SHUGAKU `func_80134F18` copies `D_80120650` to `D_801206D8` (+0x88) and stores into the copy, written as `*(Words17 *)&D_80120650[0x88] = *(Words17 *)D_80120650;` plus `D_80120650[0x8A] = 0x40` (`FAKE`). A struct copy of 0x44 bytes is `typedef struct { s32 w[17]; } Words17;` (loop of 3 words, then two words), local copy buffers need a pad word above (`func_800F7C94`).
- **Same-line trick found by the permuter.** TACO `func_80158F48`: `func_8015C0A0(0, arg0); (arg0 + D_8015EDB4)->unk7C += 1;` on one source line moves the reload of the spilled index to the original's place (`FAKE`). `tools/permute.py --time 120` is worth running whenever funcdiff shows one or two swapped instructions: it found this one and the `c[4] = c[5] = c[6] = 0` chain of `func_8013306C` within seconds, and printed a verified match. It found nothing for the register-choice cases below (best scores 10 to 1240 after 60 to 300 s).
- **Narrow parameters of a function that is called with an s16 value in a register**: TT `func_8013ED70` and the siblings use byte offsets on `u8 *` locals (`b[0x10]` is a byte, `*(u16 *)(a + 0x14)` a halfword); the two pointers `D_80158A60`/`D_80158A64` are locals (spilled to `sp+0x34/0x30`) in the first branch and read as globals in the `else if`.
- **Struct fields passed to a callee that the header knows under another name**: `func_80052648`/`func_80052C88` are `get_h_tokimeki`/`get_h_yuukou` (`u32` results: `sltiu` after the call); `func_8004F984` is `menu_check`. Writing the renamed names builds; a hand-added `u32 func_80052648();` was an alias conflict. `menu_check` returns `s8`, so its header line changed from `void` to `s8` and `menu_check_1/2` got `s8` lines (callers ignore the result).
- **Local function-pointer table of 55 entries** (DATE `func_80151F84`): `typedef struct { void (*f[55])(); } FnTbl55;` with `s32 idx;` declared before `tbl` and the call `tbl.f[idx]();` without arguments, the template of [[decompile-workflow]] step 14.
- **EVENT/DATE words with narrow overrides.** `D_801207B0`/`D_801207B4` are `s16` in EVENT (`MAIN_API_OVERRIDE_` lines in `include/ovl/EVENT.h`, then `sync_protos.py --write`); `D_8012121A/1C` are main-exe `s16` data with the same override for EVENT's `s32` view.
- **TACO actor and effect functions.** Actors (`(arg0 + D_8015EDB4)->unk7A`, a `TcPos pos` local filled field by field and passed by value to `func_8013DB80`) match on the first try from the m2c draft (`func_801570A4`). Effect spawners that call `func_8015ACCC` with `TcPos` arguments follow the family rule (locals `TcPos`, three stores of the position on one line in the order z, y, x): `func_801573C8` needs `TcPos p0; TcPos a; TcPos b;` (p0 only supplies the frame, 0x58), `func_80157AE0` `TcPos pos; TcPos b; s32 t; s32 r;` (with `t` the call result stored to `b.unk6` after `pos.z`, declared before `r` to put `r` at `sp+0x40`), `func_8015800C` `TcPos p0; TcPos p1; TcPos b;` with the global `D_801604DC` passed as the fourth argument. 1476 bytes matched without a single retry once the frame locals were right.
- **EVENT effect pages with a local 8-word table** (`func_800F8C2C`, 2000 bytes): `typedef struct { s32 a; s32 b; } EvEnt; typedef struct { EvEnt e[4]; } EvTbl;`, `tbl = D_80120A74;` and sixteen `func_800F9730(.., tbl.e[D_801207B0].a, tbl.e[D_801207B0].b, 9, 1)` calls; the sixteen draft lines were generated from the m2c text with a script (the only fix was `s32 pad[1]` above `tbl`, `FAKE`).

Found but not matched (rows in [[data/t0018-cases]]), by cause:
- **Register choice of the pointer or the constant in a small K&R function** (TT `func_80134874`, `func_80134768`, `func_80134ADC`, `func_8013EC64`, `func_80133AD0`; ENDING `func_80134B18`; GEKO `func_80133AA0`; RPG_BAT `func_80142DF4`, `func_8013F350`): the C is right instruction for instruction, the original keeps a constant (`1`, `0x20`) in `$a1`/`$a2` where IDO takes `$v1`/`$a1`, or a pointer copy in `$v1`. Eight functions share the shape; the permuter did not find a spelling in 100 to 200 s each.
- **Switch selector in `$v1`** (main `week_day_main0`, BUNKASAI `func_8013B190`) and the call result copied for an argument (`func_80074DE0`: IDO compares the copy `$a1`, the original compares `$v0`); these are the old T-0018 selector rows, now with exact drafts in the scratchpad of w7-1.
- **`lui $at` shared across symbols outside the object's data range** (TAIIKU `func_8013A63C`, `func_8013AE14`, `func_8013ACBC`; main `menu_bar_color`).
- **Argument/store register sharing** (`f(*(u8 *)&X = k)`: GEKO `func_8013CC20`, GYOZI `func_8013DC2C`, SHOUGATU `func_8013AFEC`): all instructions match, the original puts `li a0,k` before the `lui $at`.
- **Narrow parameter converted once** (DATE2 `func_80135DA4`): the table form `D_801217D0[4].unk_06 += arg0` builds the original's body, the original converts `arg0` with `sll/sra` into `$v0` once; IDO drops the conversion for every `s16` spelling tried (prototype, K&R, cast, local).
## Wave 7, list 2 (T-9320)
Ticket [[tickets/T-9320-wave-7-list-2]]. 39 functions matched (EVENT 5, TACO 19, TT 2, TEL 2, SHOUGATU 2, KANGEI 2, GEKO 1, RPG_BAT 1, OLH 1, main 4), 29 T-0018 rows added to [[data/t0018-cases]]. What worked, in the order of how many functions it unlocked:
1. **The TACO tick/spawn functions are one template: a re-tested range chain.** `t = D_8015EDB4[k].unk2; if (t < a || t >= b) { if ((u32)arg0 < D_8015EDB4[k].unk3) A } else if (t >= a && t < b) { A } if (t >= end) { reset; loop; return; } D_8015EDB4[k].unk3 += 1;`, where `A` is the callee call, `unk2 += 1`, `unk3 = 0`, `t = unk2`. The else-branch repeats the range test (IDO keeps the redundant compare), and a `&` between the two halves (`(t >= 0x1E) & (t < 0x28)`, `func_8014C978`) gives the `xori`/`and` form. Record index k comes from the byte offset: `off / 0x88`, field = `off % 0x88` (`unk2`, `unk3`, `unk78`, `unk84[0..2]`, `pad0[1]`). Reset block: `unk84[2] = 0; unk3 = unk2 = unk84[2];` (one load, two stores) or the all-constant chain `unk3 = unk2 = unk84[2] = 0`, whichever the asm shows.
2. **Loops over two parallel tables take a second counter and the table symbols the asm names.** `for (i = 1, j = 0; i != 0x1F; i++, j++) func_801472D4(i, k, D_8015FEF8[j * 2 - 2], D_8015FEF8[j * 2 - 1], D_8015FFE2[j * 2 - 2], D_8015FFE2[j * 2 - 1]);` gives the `lw a2,-8(s1)` pointer walk, and the stack argument store lands in the `jal` slot (T-9210 idiom). Declare each base symbol the asm uses (`D_8015FEF8`, not `D_8015FEF0 + 2`: IDO folds the offset and the displacement changes). A counter-only `i` with `D_8015FEF0[i * 2 - 2]` also matches when the start is `arg2` (`func_8014B5F0`). Pointer loops compared with a different symbol (`q != D_80127ED0`) get the run-time remainder loop; compare with `base + N`.
3. **`if (func(...) != X)` and repeated reads of one expression are not a variable.** Where m2c prints a `temp_v0 = D_8015EDB4->unkA9E; if (temp_v0 == 1 || temp_v0 == 2)`, the original repeats the expression (`D_8015EDB4[19].unk84[2] == 1 || D_8015EDB4[19].unk84[2] == 2`); a local gives the compare operands the other way round (`beq v0,v1` against `beq v1,v0`, KANGEI `func_80136BF4`, TACO `func_8014FBD4`). The converse holds when the asm keeps the value in `$v1` across calls (KANGEI `func_801362F0`: a real variable).
4. **A temp the original skips is a redundant operation the permuter can find.** TACO `func_8014B5F0` (`t = *arg1 ^ 0`) and `func_8014F9B0` (`if ((f() != X) != 0)`) match once one extra no-op burns a temporary; run `permute.py` for 150 s when only the `$tN` numbers are shifted by one. Both are marked `FAKE`. It did not help when the difference is which register holds a value (`$a1` against `$v0`).
5. **Single-bit mask tests are `sll; bltz`.** `x & 0x80000000` and `x & 0x40000000` on an `s32` field give `sll t,x,0; bltz` and `sll t,x,1; bgez` (`sprite_set_gpu_poly_ft4`, flags of the `Rec24` sprite records: bit 31 hides, bit 30 is semi-transparent). A bit-field struct gives `srl`/`sra` instead. Halfword fields read unsigned in the original (`lhu`) need `(u16)` on the member.
6. **Scene inits and state machines are copies of their siblings.** Search the same overlay for a matched function with the same callees (`tools`-less: grep a distinctive call) and rename: SHOUGATU `func_80139EC8`/`func_8013B758` from `func_8013AB5C`, EVENT `func_800FE494` from `func_800FC994`, `func_800FA8B8`/`func_800FAD28` from `func_8010B970`, OLH `func_801345CC` from `func_80133C4C`, TEL `func_80132138` text, GEKO `func_80134538` from `func_801410A4`. Constants and offsets are all that change; the string literal is written in UTF-8 and the object's rodata follows (EVENT: `func_80036884("")` is the word `""`, funcdiff shows a `.rodata` relocation and only the sha1 decides).
7. **GameState bytes read as scalars: `*(u8 *)&D_800E6280.unk_110D`.** Needed in TEL, KANGEI, GEKO and main state machines to keep `lui a0; lbu a0,0(a0)` (T-9020). It does not reproduce a first read whose address register the original took from the scalar's own `lui` when other `D_800E6280` members are used in the same block (OMIMAI `func_80132670`).
8. **Frame pad.** A scene init with a local `RECT` needs `s32 pad;` declared above it when the original rect sits 4 bytes lower (KANGEI `func_801338EC`); unused locals count only when another local lives in memory.
9. **Reaching two neighbours through one symbol keeps as1 from hoisting the second load** (RPG_BAT `func_80155E80`: `(&D_8015EC28)[10] = (&D_8015EC28)[0] - 0xEC; (&D_8015EC28)[11] = (&D_8015EC28)[1] - 0x17;`, FAKE). The same effect with a scalar view: TACO `func_8014A070` stores `(&D_80127090)[j].unk0`.
Open in [[data/t0018-cases]]: `func_8014B8B4`/`func_8014E5F8` (constants `li v1,0x800` before `li v0,0x40`), `func_8014F5F0`, `func_8014F820`, `func_801511C0` (temp numbering), `geko_judge` (frame), `load_string`, `func_8006190C`, the EVENT `func_800FA194`/`func_800FA0D0` loops (counter in `$a0`).
## Wave 7, list 8 (T-9380)
Ticket [[tickets/T-9380-wave-7-list-8]]. 27 functions matched (about 5,800 bytes), three more drafts behind `NON_MATCHING` (EN_NICHI `func_80137C58`, TT `func_8014CC04`, `func_8014B088`), 21 rows in [[data/t0018-cases]]. New patterns:
- **The permuter finds the hack the hand search does not, and "did not survive the real build" can be wrong.** Run `tools/permute.py ... all <func> --time 200 -j 9` on a draft that is 1-5 instructions off. Eight wins here came out of it (DATE `func_8013FA6C`, `func_8014E38C`; SHOUGATU `func_80133D98`; NAME_ENT `func_80146BCC`; EN_NICHI `func_80137E2C`; ENDING `func_80137160`; TT `func_8014D168`). When it prints `score 0` and then `declarations outside the function were changed` it still says `ninja object + funcdiff --resolve: MATCH` and `unit sha1: OK`: take the function body from `build/permute/<func>/output-0-1/source.c` and strip what is not needed. What it found, all marked `FAKE` in the source: a dead duplicate of the whole constant chain in front of the real one (the first copy is dropped by uopt, but its `li` is scheduled first), an empty `do { } while (0)` after a global load, a `if ((D && D) && D) {}` that makes a global's load the first instruction, `p = &GameState.unk_F5F` before an unrelated store (puts the `lui` of the selector first), a loop-bound local `n = 0x80` plus a never-taken `if (1)` after a case (gives the bound its own register apart from the case constant 0x80), and `g = &D_800E6280; n = ++g->unk_1104.u;` (moves the counter from `$v0` to `$v1`).
- **Temporary ids follow the C tree, not the asm order.** A `for (i = 0; i < 2; i++)` makes ugen number the increment's temporaries before the body's (ENDING `func_80137160`: `do { ... i += 1; } while (i < 2)` gave `sll t8` where the original has `sll t4`); a cast such as `(u8)(f() & 0x7F)` consumes one id (DATE `func_80136A74`); IDO evaluates the right operand of `==` first, so `(v & 0xF) == D` and `D == (v & 0xF)` number their temporaries in opposite order (DATE `func_8013D174` needs one of each).
- **Constants held in locals keep the original's constant registers** (DATE `func_8013A344`: `two = 2; three = 3;` inside the `else`; `bne v1,v0` instead of `bne v0,v1`), but not at function level when the constant is a plain compare (DATE `func_8013E3C4`, EN_NICHI `func_80137C58`: `bne s7,v1` against `bne v1,s7` stays open).
- **`D_x++ == k` on a GameState byte/word, written `D_800E6280.unk_F5E--` plus `unk_75E[unk_F5E - 1].unk_02 == 1`,** is the whole 100-byte family of ten DATE date-spot helpers (`func_80137920` and nine twins differing in one `func_8007ED84` argument); `neardupes.py` did not pick them up, the constants were substituted by hand.
- **Narrow K&R callee without prototype** (RPG_BAT `func_8013A2F4`): `func_8013A464` was an ANSI `(s8 a0, s8 a1)` definition; the original calls it with `0xFF` and `0x80` unconverted and the definition after the caller. Declare `void func_8013A464();` before the caller and write the definition old-style (`a0, a1` with `s8 a0; s8 a1;`): the definition still matches and `check_headers.py` accepts the pair. `D_80121317` (main_api: `s8`) needed a file override to store `0x80` as 128.
- **Two-way switch tables carry an explicit extra case** (RPG_BAT `func_801439E0`: 15 table entries, the last one jumps to the exit; `case 14: break;` after `case 13`).
- **`andi a1,s5,0xffff` for a hoisted 0x40** (TT `func_8014B088`, behind `NON_MATCHING`): the callee `func_8014AFB8` is ANSI `(u8 *, u16, s32)` (matched now), but IDO folds the constant argument with its prototype (`li a1,64`); the original keeps the hoisted register and the `u16` conversion. Not solved.
- **GPU tag address field is a 24-bit bit-field** (TT `func_8014CC04`, behind `NON_MATCHING`): `typedef struct { u32 addr : 24; u32 len : 8; } TtOtTag` and `((TtOtTag *)v)->addr = ot_word;` gives the original's `and; xor; sll 8; srl 8; xor` exactly (one `addu` operand order left).
- **Own data**: `data_island.py NAME_ENT/80144AD0` leaves out the labels that only a data pointer names (60 pieces exist, 13 `INCLUDE_RODATA` lines are written) and the overlay sha1 then fails; the missing lines must be added by hand (every `.s` in `asm/ovl/<NAME>/data/<NAME>/<obj>.data/`, in address order). Islands added: DATE `8014CC40` and `80132000`, NAME_ENT `80144AD0`, EN_NICHI `80136B10` (the last one with `u16 D_80139C58` and the `u8 D_80139C34[8]`, `D_80139C3C[8]`, `D_80139C44[8]`, `s16 D_80139C4C[6]` tables).
- **Open families** (details in the data file): the NAME_ENT quartet `func_80147F78`/`func_801469D0`/`func_80147A80`/`func_80149144` (1,450 bytes; all instructions match, `a` sits in `$v1`/sum in `$a0` against `$a1`/`$v1`, frame 0x38); the DATE table readers `func_801366A4`, `func_80136B70`, `func_80136D3C`, `func_80139944`, ... (repeated `li k; multu` for six identical products: IDO CSEs them, no spelling found); the selector `$v1` against `$v0` (BUNKAKEN `func_801428D0`, RPG_BAT `func_80136A9C`, NAME_ENT `func_80145378`); the promoted-global register (`$v1`/`$a0` against `$v0`: DATE `func_8013E6A4`, `func_80140D38`, `func_8014DB98`, `func_8014E010`, NAME_ENT `func_80140B20`, EVENT `func_8010A790`).

## Tooling fixes, wave 7 (T-9400)
[[tickets/T-9400-wave-7-tool-fixes]]: dupes/neardupes --files selects exact main/<addr> or OVL/<addr> paths; a bare address selects main only, never another overlay with the same stem. data_island emits all data_pieces starts, including pointer-only labels; define an aggregate by replacing every covered include. sync_protos --write takes () from K&R definitions. funcdiff ignores internal .L headers, resolves external original strings from the scoped unit's rodata (including empty literals), and ends every DIFF with a verdict. OPTION func_8013C52C is now an automatic table-reference MATCH; GEKO func_8013CD18 resolves to naming-only and --resolve MATCH. The unit checksum still verifies actual table and string placement.
Permute's false negative came from its final outside-declaration veto even when only the body was inserted and both funcdiff and sha1 passed. Outside edits are advisory; the unchanged real declarations plus full build are the judge. build/symbols.ok rejects overlay addresses in the shared main symbol file. Orphan strings require separate objects when they follow an earlier object's tables: the isolated TACO hidden-boundary split passed sha1; recipe and limitations in [[build-system]]. No source functions were gained in this tooling ticket.
## Register-allocation shapes after wave 7 (T-9410)

Inventory, exact cluster counts, experiment bounds and proof: [[register-allocation-wave7]]. tools/register_shapes.py joins the 1,088 historical rows to original asm and current source state: 718 distinct functions, initially 374 open. Five gains (2,768 bytes): main func_8005AE60, ENDING func_80138278/func_8013855C/func_80138FC8/func_801391E4. The main selector uses a plain u8 local after the call. ENDING uses a marked FAKE dead dividend test before `% 240`; func_8013855C also uses a marked FAKE s16 constant local for comparison operand order. Idioms in [[decompile-workflow]]. Two row anchors are now resolved; three gains were family members without separate rows. Final progress 4734/6958, clean 27/27 checksums and all guards pass. Constant ordering, DATE product CSE and fade/girl copies remain open; finite spelling searches do not prove them impossible from C. No compiler pass added.

## Wave 8, list 3 (T-9530)

Work list: 136 functions in 36 owned C files. Attempts use Docker IDO 5.3, the current K&R/cvt/frame pipeline, resolved function diffs, and linked-unit SHA1 checks. Drafts and failed experiments stay in the shared scratchpad's `w8-3/` directory. Non-matches are restored to `INCLUDE_ASM` before proceeding.

- TAIIKU `func_801345A4`: ordinary scene switch, using the existing timer/fade names and the signed scroll-position halfword.
- TAIIKU `func_80134D94`: reuse one `s32` counter for both cleanup loops. Separate m2c counters allow IDO to replace the first `< 23` test with `!= 23`; reusing the counter retains `slti`.
- GYOZI `func_8013CB18`: the existing `GirlFlag4` bit-field view fixes the first flag-store temporary and all subsequent temporary numbers. Use the girl index and the club byte through `GyoziWork`.
- RPG_BAT `func_80141C70`, `func_80141E38`, `func_8013E300`: restore the third argument `500` to `func_8014B738`; its matched definition takes three arguments, but m2c inferred only two. Use the existing `RpgBatWords3` fields for the counter and next-state word.
- TACO `func_80153774`: preserve each explicit lower/upper range test and the early returns; the ordinary range chain matches without dummy locals or scheduling tricks.

## Tooling fixes, wave 8 (T-9600)

Ticket [[tickets/T-9600-wave-8-tool-fixes]]. Tool-only changes, no new C matches.

- register_shapes accepts a function or --unit UNIT function, plus UNIT:function. Missing original assembly is skipped with a stderr note; unresolved identities remain errors. See [[register-allocation-wave7]].
- Permuter worker type lookup includes K&R param_decls, default-int formals and implicit int () callees such as delete. This adapts upstream at worker startup; compiler input retains its original signature and lines. Other K&R bodies are stripped correctly too.
- Funcdiff resolves R_MIPS_PC16 using text-symbol section offsets (or function VRAM for named external targets), including the instruction's signed branch addend. It resolves absolute D_7FFFFF. Scheduled string HI16s compare as string-base references: the first following linker LO16 does not uniquely identify the string used along a branch. Every LO16 still compares its own string bytes, and changed contents remain differences. The reported RPG_BAT func_80154430/func_8014E780, TACO func_801361E8 and main strNextVlc now pass ordinary resolved comparisons without scratch references.
- Negative-SP report: SHOUGATU func_80140314, detailed in [[tickets/T-9580-wave-8-list-8]]. The target has a legitimate lbu displacement -0x428 through sp+year-derived-index; the failed draft used -1080. The frame pass now shifts negative displacements on tracked sp+variable-index registers by 16, preserving the local origin when the index includes a positive bias. Direct negative sp offsets (also through plain copies of sp) still fail, as do cross-label and unsupported uses. A real IDO test copies a 48-byte local table and reads table[12*(year-95)]: its origin moves from sp+24 to sp+40, so displacement -1116 becomes -1100. This is the same local movement, with no function-specific switch.
- InitMouse's two table stores collapse in upstream m2c, reproduced directly with synthetic assembly and context, before wrapper postprocessing. The wrapper leaves both original LO16 symbols intact. Workaround: write D_800E36C0[0] = arg0; D_800E36C0[1] = arg1; from the two word-store addresses 0x800E36C0/4. Rewriting the second relocation as base+4 alone does not fix upstream either. The existing shared-at/data-ownership blocker remains separate; no match is claimed.
- dupes and neardupes share plan_copy. Constant pointer views are resolved to their effective source address before symbol translation, then mapped through migrate_globals.find_mapping with their access type. GYOZI func_80137D70 uses (&D_800F5AAE)[0x9CC], whose effective symbol D_800F647A maps to GameState+0x110A; retaining the old displacement after mapping the base reached +0x10EA instead. Unknown types or absent effective relocations cause a clear skip.
- check_headers and sync_protos --fix preflight every header, including inactive branches, for unmatched conditionals, unclosed braces, and typedefs inside struct/union bodies. Diagnostics name the file and line; sync refuses malformed input before rewriting any file. Anonymous nested aggregate members remain valid.

Regression tests and final clean build/review evidence are recorded in the ticket.

## uopt allocation traces and uniform experiments (T-9800)

See [[uopt-register-allocation]] and
[[tickets/T-9800-uopt-register-allocation-trace-and-uniform-patch]]. The repaired
recomp prints the Chow-Hennessy allocator trace. Its zero-profit global ranges
must be distinguished from profitable expression/local ranges: a final `andi`
or a v0 selector does not establish that the global itself was promoted.
Unconstrained leaf ranges use bit-position order, not priority order; constrained
ranges break equal priority in favor of the earlier bit position. The measured
formula, cost gates, register order and `-regr` branches are on the research page.

The experiments keep the ordinary cc.py pipeline and game sources unchanged.
Their corpus includes current best compiling wave drafts and fresh m2c output;
stock-uopt draft hits are separate from allocator gains. Whole linked units are
checked in addition to resolved function instructions. Per-cluster trace notes
explain where source lifetime, shared expressions, return behavior, CSE or
aggregate layout remain the more specific question. No allocator emulation
pass has been added to the default build.

Final T-9800 verdict: none of eight uniform candidates preserves all 4870
matches. Later constant-only priority ties gain TT func_801475C8 (124 bytes,
three historical rows) but preserve only 4209/4870 literal linked spans.
Preferring a2/a3 gains TT func_80134ADC and func_80145370 (584 bytes, five rows)
but preserves only 3653/4870. The three distinct isolated gains have literal
link proof at original addresses; they are not integrated. Matched
tpage_buf_clear demonstrates the opposite constant-tie order, so the TT gain
cannot justify a blanket rule. No game C or default compiler behavior changes.

The final TAIIKU timer trace explains the indirect-read FAKE more precisely.
With the direct scalar, the global range (bit 2) has priority 0.5 and receives
colour 1 (v0), while the timer local (bit 0) receives colour 3 (a0). With the
indirect halfword expression, bit 2 has priority zero and is not allocated;
bit 0's priority rises from 1 to 4/3 and retains a0. This removes the extra
global-to-local copy. Both trace cases compile; the indirect source matches
and the direct scalar has 13 edits. Evidence is in scratchpad/w11-3/trace-timer/
and trace-timer-manifest.json; production compiler/tools remain unchanged.
